title: fix(form,record-details): a field group whose visibleWhen faults is hidden, header and members (objectui#13055)
body:
Fixes #13055
Clause-②: yes

## What

A field group whose `visibleWhen` cannot be evaluated is now HIDDEN on the form and on `record:details`, header and members both. Evaluation fails on a parse error, an unknown field or root, or an evaluation error. `@objectstack/spec` declares this slot fail-closed: `ObjectFieldGroupSchema.visibleWhen` says "else hidden (fail-closed)". Before this change both surfaces failed open. The one-time diagnostic stays and now names the default taken: `safe default (false)` and "the group is hidden".

Only this origin changes. These all keep today's fail-open:

- an authored form-view `FormSection.visibleWhen` (declared to fault open),
- a field's own `visibleWhen` / `readonlyWhen` / `requiredWhen` (ADR-0137 D3),
- every other predicate slot.

There is no global fallback flip.

## How: the fault direction travels with the predicate (seat ruling 6272824447, Q1 = A)

On the form, a field group's predicate and a form-view section's own predicate both land in one slot: a `section-divider` row's (or a tab's) `visibleWhen`. The renderer cannot honour both directions from the slot alone, so the direction rides with the predicate.

- **One key, a closed enum: `visibleWhenFault?: 'hidden' | 'shown'`.** Absent means today's fail-open.
  - It is declared on the `@object-ui/types` row types that carry it: `ObjectFormSection`, `FormField` (`section-divider` rows only, ignored elsewhere) and `FormFieldTab`.
  - It is mirrored on the zod faces (`FormFieldSchema`, the module-private `FormFieldTabEntrySchema`).
  - Why this name: it sits beside the slot it qualifies, `visibleWhen`, and uses the tree's existing fault vocabulary (`faults.visibleWhen`, `FieldRuleFaults`, `onFault`). Its values name the outcome ('hidden' / 'shown') rather than a boolean, so a reader never has to ask what `true` means.
  - It is a runtime hand-off, not an authoring key. The spec's strict `FormSectionSchema` refuses it in authored metadata.
- **Stamp.** `deriveFieldGroupSections` (`plugin-form/src/fieldGroups.ts`) writes `'hidden'` beside every group predicate it copies. Both routes a group reaches the form pass through it: the no-sections `fieldGroups` fallback, and an authored `{ group }` reference via `resolveSectionGroupReferences`.
- **Carry.** The key is copied beside `visibleWhen` at every key-by-key rebuild:
  - `ObjectForm` x5 (tabbed, split, drawer and modal maps, plus the simple grouped arm),
  - `ModalForm` (the group map, the tab copy, the stacked and derived projections),
  - `DrawerForm` x2,
  - `SplitForm`,
  - `TabbedForm` (the tab group, the degraded gate row, the tab copy),
  - the console `FormPage` section rebuild.

  `projectSectionDivider` copies it onto both row shapes and omits it when absent.
- **Read.** In `@object-ui/components` `renderers/form/form.tsx`, `isFailClosedSectionGate` takes a stamped divider's predicate off the triad call, and `sectionGateVisible` evaluates it with fallback `false`. This happens at every site that judges a divider:
  - `renderFormField`,
  - `hiddenSectionFieldNames` (the claimed members),
  - `conditionallyHiddenFieldNames`,
  - `readonlyFieldNames`, which only drops it from the triad.

  The warning is deduped per predicate text, first site wins, so every site uses the fail-closed locator. `hiddenFieldTabKeys` takes `!failClosed` as the tab's fallback. The console `FormPage`'s `isSectionVisible` does the same for its own section gate.
- **Detail page.** `record-details.tsx` `sectionPredicateVisible` now calls `evalFieldPredicate(..., false, ...)`. It only ever judges `{ group }` references, so there is no fail-open origin to tell apart there.

There is no pane gate to change: `FormFieldPane` declares no predicate slot. The split layout gates through the same `section-divider` rows inside each pane, which carry the key.

## Q2 = A: fault-hidden members behave exactly like FALSE-hidden members

Their values still submit and their client-side validation is skipped, per the 2026-08-27 maintainer ruling cited in `form.tsx` (objectui#6236). The hide goes through the same `hiddenSectionFieldNames` set a FALSE verdict uses. `section-gate-fail-closed-13055` pins the equivalence, running the same two assertions over a FALSE-hidden group and a FAULT-hidden group.

## Pins

- **(a)** `packages/components/src/renderers/form/__tests__/section-gate-fail-closed-13055.test.tsx`:
  - parse fault (`record.kind ==`) and unknown field (`record.no_such_field == 'x'`) hide heading and members;
  - the diagnostic contains `safe default (false)` and "the group is hidden";
  - a stamped tab is hidden: trigger, panel and members.
- **(a)** `packages/plugin-form/src/__tests__/fieldGroupFaultClosed-13055.test.tsx`, end to end through `ObjectForm`:
  - the fieldGroups fallback;
  - a `{ group }` reference on the simple, tabbed, split, drawer and modal layouts.

  Both faults hide the group on each.
- **(a)** `record:details`: `record-details.groupVisibleWhen-11630.test.tsx` now asserts fail-closed on both surfaces for a bare unbound identifier, a parse error and an unknown field (new row). `record-highlights.groupGate-12720.test.tsx`'s fault leg now reads zero members on the page.
- **(b) controls:**
  - a well-formed `record.kind == 'pro'` shows on `pro` and hides on `basic`, on every layout and on the renderer;
  - an unstamped divider or tab (a form-view section's own predicate) that faults still shows, with `safe default (true)`;
  - a divider stamped `'shown'` still shows;
  - an authored form-view section's faulting `visibleWhen` still shows on all five layouts;
  - a faulting FIELD-level `visibleWhen` still shows its field, even with the key on it.
- **(c) enumeration pin:** `packages/plugin-form/src/__tests__/sectionFaultCarry-13055.test.ts`.
  - It scans every non-test source of `plugin-form` plus the console `FormPage.tsx`, comments masked with `scripts/js-comment-mask.mjs`, for `visibleWhen: RECV.visibleWhen,` copies.
  - Every section-receiver copy must be followed by `visibleWhenFault: RECV.visibleWhenFault,`.
  - An unclassified receiver fails loudly.
  - Per-file site counts keep the scanner live.
  - It also pins the stamp and the projection behaviourally.

## Ablations (each mutation through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, which proves the anchor landed and restores by blob hash)

1. **Drop the stamp** (`fieldGroups.ts`), running `fieldGroupFaultClosed-13055` + `sectionFaultCarry-13055`: 7 failed and 11 passed. Every (a) leg went red (fallback plus the five `{ group }` layouts) and so did the stamp pin. Every (b) control, the enumeration and the projection pins stayed green. Restore: blob `a58736697288` == HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty.
2. **Drop the key from one rebuild arm** (`SplitForm.tsx`), running `sectionFaultCarry-13055`: 1 failed and 5 passed. The red line was the carry pin, naming `packages/plugin-form/src/SplitForm.tsx` and its next line. Restore: blob `e0568fd88907` == HEAD, diff empty.
3. **record:details back to fail-open** (`record-details.tsx`, fallback `false` to `true`), running the 11630 and 12720 suites: 4 failed and 12 passed. The three fault rows and the 12720 fault leg went red; the well-formed and control rows stayed green. Restore: blob `f9f875acbd5a` == HEAD, diff empty.
4. **Renderer gate back to fail-open** (`form.tsx` `sectionGateVisible`, fallback `false` to `true`), running `section-gate-fail-closed-13055`: 4 failed and 9 passed. Red: the two (a) divider legs and the two Q2 FAULT legs. Green: every control and the Q2 FALSE legs. The stamped-tab leg also stayed green, because the tab gate is a separate fallback (`!failClosed` in `hiddenFieldTabKeys`), not `sectionGateVisible`.

## Acceptance notes

- **Not this card:** authoring still accepts a syntactically broken group `visibleWhen` (`record.kind ==`) with a 200. A parse-time check on this slot is a separate authoring-side question.
  - `content/docs/plugins/plugin-form.mdx` "Conditional tabs" says a tab predicate "fails open".
  - The `plugin-form` README rule table says "Fail open" for the triad (still true for the triad).

  A tab built from a field group now fails closed. The docs follow-up can be a separate docs edit.
- `app-shell`'s metadata-admin `SchemaForm` calls `resolveSectionGroupReferences` but resolves `{ group }` against no object field groups (its own header: such a section resolves empty). It never carries a group predicate, so it is untouched.
- **Pre-existing, unchanged:** the split layout draws (and so gates) a section's row only when it has a `label` or `description`. A headingless field group on `formType: 'split'` therefore has no gate at all, fail-open or fail-closed. This is noted in the docs' "Section rows" paragraph.
- **Sentence for the seat's contract review:** a key with these semantics invites an author to write it by hand on a form-view section. The strict spec face refuses it, while the `@object-ui/types` zod mirror now accepts it, the supported route `zod-mirror-parity` allows for a declared key.

  - a tab or section built from an object field group fails CLOSED, per `ObjectFieldGroupSchema.visibleWhen`;
  - a form-view section or tab predicate, and a field's own `visibleWhen`, keep failing open.
- **Merged `origin/main`** (3 commits, no conflicts).
- **Verification:** targeted tests 9 files, 78 passed. `check:doc-types`, `check:doc-snippets`, `check:doc-examples`, `check:doc-json`, `check:doc-fences`, `check:control-bytes` and `check:new-line-citations` all exit 0 (the snippet, example and JSON gates after the scoped build each names).
